sonnet.problem: The story card retells 'too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg', the very fact card 4 just asked about and revealed. It repeats an answer that was already shown.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The question asks whether the manager lowers the second debt. Card 8 already established that he cut the first debt from a hundred to fifty, so the card re-asks the same point (he reduces the bill) instead of something new.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
